title: Think Before You Act: Decision Gate for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.38620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly perform consequential actions through external tools, yet their proposed actions are often executed without independent verification of policy compliance or task completion. We introduce JevAct, a runtime verification framework that intercepts selected agent actions before execution and enables feedback-driven correction. JevAct compiles domain policies into executable state checks and structured questions evaluated by a prefill-only decision model, which produces probability-based judgments without relying on LLM generation. By combining deterministic verification of tool-state facts with probabilistic assessment of conversational context, the framework identifies potentially invalid actions and premature task termination, providing targeted feedback for bounded revision. JevAct operates independently of the underlying agent model and requires no modifications to its parameters or tools. We evaluate JevAct across

translated_title: 三思而后行：面向大语言模型智能体的决策门控
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地通过外部工具执行具有重大影响的操作，然而它们提出的动作往往在未经独立验证是否符合策略或是否完成任务的情况下就被执行。我们提出了JevAct，一个运行时验证框架，它在执行前拦截选定的智能体动作，并支持基于反馈的修正。JevAct将领域策略编译为可执行的状态检查和结构化问题，由一个仅预填充（prefill-only）的决策模型进行评估，该模型生成基于概率的判断，而不依赖大语言模型的生成。通过将工具状态事实的确定性验证与对话上下文的概率评估相结合，该框架能够识别潜在无效的动作和过早的任务终止，为受限的修订提供有针对性的反馈。JevAct独立于底层智能体模型运行，无需修改其参数或工具。我们在……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出运行时验证框架JevAct，在智能体动作执行前拦截并通过确定性工具状态检查与基于概率的策略判断识别无效动作和过早任务终止，提供反馈驱动的受限修正，且无需修改底层智能体模型的参数或工具。
en_tdlr: JevAct is a runtime verification framework that intercepts LLM agent actions before execution, combining deterministic tool-state checks with probability-based policy judgments to detect invalid actions and premature task termination, enabling feedback-driven bounded revision without modifying the underlying agent model's parameters or tools.
